data.description:
## Description
INSTALL.md lines 124, 184 instruct users to configure a 'Sprint Story Review' check matching the name: field in .github/workflows/per-branch-review.yml. The workflow was deleted in commit 4b18d2d644 (story 20d7-09d6). New-install ruleset setup will fail attempting to reference a non-existent workflow.

## Impact
P2 — breaks new project installs that follow INSTALL.md instructions.

## Fix
Update INSTALL.md to reference ci.yml's llm-review as the canonical PR check name (or remove the Sprint Story Review check from required setup entirely).

## Found By
completion-verifier during story 20d7-09d6 closure
data.title: INSTALL.md ruleset setup references deleted per-branch-review.yml workflow name
